description: Read-only transaction check. Verifies product match, credential, signed mandate when supplied or required, exact offer allowlist, price ceiling, current terms, sanitized scope, capacity, and payment-route readiness. It creates no intent, checkout, charge, order, or telemetry event.

acquisition_channel.description: Optional allowlisted discovery source for privacy-minimized revenue attribution.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token returned with a matched offer. Include it so acknowledgement, authority, checkout, and funding remain one correlated journey.

request_id.description: Buyer-scoped idempotency key. Reuse it only when retrying this exact purchase attempt.

funding_method.description: Choose stripe_delegated_card only when an organization owner or administrator has completed the Stripe-hosted saved-card setup; otherwise use stripe_mpp_card.

mandate_token.description: Optional principal-issued signed single-transaction mandate. Required when Zinvyl's signed-mandate enforcement is enabled.

maximum_amount.description: Maximum authorized amount in minor currency units (cents); 4900 means $49.00.

task_summary.description: One sanitized bounded outcome. Never include credentials, tokens, payment data, personal data, confidential files, or production secrets.

name: preflight_agent_purchase
title: Preflight one agent purchase without creating an order
